tools.name: browse_blog
tools.description: Open the blog list UI in this tab. Optionally filter by category or tag slug from list_blog_categories / search results.

category.description: Optional category slug hub to open.

tag.description: Optional tag slug hub to open. Ignored when category is set.

tools.name: get_page_context
tools.description: Return safe context for the open Pkaso tab: route slug, params, path, document title, locale, whether the user appears signed in (boolean only), unread message badge count, and PWA standalone mode. Call this first when planning actions.

tools.name: list_blog_categories
tools.description: List active blog categories with slugs and names. Use category slugs with search_blog_posts or browse_blog.

tools.name: list_mini_apps
tools.description: List public Pkaso mini-apps the user can open. Returns route slugs, titles, categories, and premium flags. Use before navigate_to_app when choosing a destination.

tools.name: navigate_to_app
tools.description: Navigate the open Pkaso tab to a public app or core page by route slug (for example home, blog, search, consultation). Prefer list_mini_apps or site_search to discover destinations. For blog posts use open_blog_post; for blog category/tag hubs use browse_blog. Call get_page_context when you need the current tab state.

slug.description: Route slug such as home, blog, search, or a mini-app route from list_mini_apps.

tools.name: open_blog_post
tools.description: Open a published blog article in this tab by its post slug (from search_blog_posts).

slug.description: Post slug, for example from search_blog_posts results.

tools.name: search_blog_posts
tools.description: Search published Pkaso blog posts by keyword and optional category/tag slug. Returns compact post summaries (slug, title, excerpt). Use open_blog_post to open one result in the tab.

q.description: Search keywords (Persian or English). Optional; omit to list recent posts.

page.description: 1-based page number (10 posts per page). Default 1.

tools.name: site_search
tools.description: Universal Pkaso search across mini-apps, blog posts, courses, podcasts, forums, and shortcuts. Returns compact hits with an open hint: use open_blog_post or navigate_to_app as indicated; for method external only show the URL to the user (do not auto-open).

query.description: Search keywords in Persian or English.
